y-m-16-08.title: Ukuvavanya isibakala sikaHajun 'ukongeza inani elifanayo kuyishiya injalo'
y-m-16-08.topic: Ukuthelekisa ubungakanani bamaqhezu: ukutshintsha inani elingasentla nelingaphantsi kunye
y-m-16-08.goal: Gweba isibakala sokuba ukongeza inani elifanayo kwinani elingasentla nelingaphantsi kushiya ubungakanani beqhezu bungatshintshanga ngokujonga ukuba imizekelo ngamaqhezu anjani, ubonise ngemizekelo echasayo indlela ubungakanani butshintsha ngayo kumaqhezu angaphantsi kwe-1 nakwabo bangaphezulu kwe-1, uze uqikelele okwenzeka kwiqhezu xa inani elongezwayo lenziwa likhulu kakhulu.
y-m-16-08.material: UHajun wongeze u-2 kwinani elingasentla nelingaphantsi kumaqhezu 4/4 (ezine kwezine) kunye ne-7/7 (esixhenxe kwesixhenxe). Aba yi-6/6 kunye ne-9/9, kwaye omabini angu-1, ngoko ubungakanani bahlala bunjalo. UHajun uthe, “Nokuba wongeza inani elifanayo kwinani elingasentla nelingaphantsi leqhezu, ubungakanani beqhezu buhlala bunjalo. Kunjengokuhlula ngenani elifanayo xa unciphisa!”

y-m-16-06.material:
